style.vernacular: The "pink city" built of volcanic tuff: rose, orange, ochre and grey-violet cut stone in the Tamanian neo-Armenian centre and Soviet-era blocks of four to six storeys with carved cornices, arcades, balconies and arched doorways; dark basalt for plinths, steps and temples; large-panel grey concrete housing estates with flat roofs on the outskirts; newer glass-and-stone-clad towers and malls; medieval churches in grey or dark tuff with conical umbrella domes and carved khachkar crosses; low flat-roofed houses of stone and render in surrounding villages among apricot, poplar and plane trees.
style.ornament: Carved arcades and arched doorways, geometric and floral relief in tuff, khachkar cross-stones, conical umbrella domes on octagonal drums, Tamanian neo-Armenian cornices and corbels, wrought-iron balconies, and Soviet pilasters and bas-reliefs.
